title: CommitTreeAdapter
responsibility: Reads the files of one exact commit from the Git object database.

inputs.name: CommitTreeAdapter.open.root
inputs.description: Repository root passed to GitAdapter for revision lookup and object reads. It selects which repository this adapter uses.

inputs.name: CommitTreeAdapter.open.reference
inputs.description: Revision expression resolved with git rev-parse --verify --quiet after appending ^{commit}. It must resolve to a commit in the selected repository.

inputs.name: CommitTreeAdapter.read.path
inputs.description: Repository-relative path matched exactly against the selected commit tree. It must identify a blob listed in that commit; this method does not normalize the path.

outputs.name: CommitTreeAdapter.open
outputs.description: An adapter bound to the selected repository and the commit resolved from reference; its revision property is the resolved commit ID. Opening fails if the expression does not identify a commit.

outputs.name: CommitTreeAdapter.list
outputs.description: The recursive list of blob files in the adapter’s exact commit, each represented by its repository-relative path and Git object hash. Entries that do not match the blob-line format are omitted.

outputs.name: CommitTreeAdapter.read
outputs.description: The UTF-8 decoded contents of the blob at path in the adapter’s exact commit. It rejects when no listed entry has that exact path.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown by read when the requested path is absent from the selected commit tree.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Raised through fail when the supplied revision expression does not name a commit in the selected repository.
